name: Lazy K's Campground and Canoe Livery
evidence: satellite (Esri, 700 m frame) at 38.4413,-81.4685: the RV Life pin sits at the Elk River bank where the primitive tent sites are; the RV loops and trailers are ~250 m south in woods around a small pond, with forest between them and the river - not waterfront (pin moved onto the RV area)

name: Smokey Bottom Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 260 m frame) at 38.9150,-79.8200: a row of ~8 RV pads runs along the creek on the campground's west edge, trailers 5-10 m from the bank on open ground (leaf-off); the operator sells these as 'creek side sites' at +$10

name: Camp Holly
evidence: satellite (Esri, 700 m frame) at 38.5617,-80.4482: the RV lane follows a creek under full canopy, so pads aren't resolvable; the operator designates numbered sites #4-10 as a 'treelined creekside full-hookup RV lane' (per-site designation), with a stocked pond 250 m N

name: Kick Back N Camp
evidence: satellite (Esri, 220 m frame) at 39.0346,-80.0395: the easternmost pull-through spurs end 10-25 m from the pond's west edge across open, unused lawn (a few trees on the SW bank only) -> open-apron frontage on the pond

name: Lost River Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 700 m frame) at 38.9556,-78.8108: an oval RV loop between the road and a crop field; the Lost River runs ~100 m north behind the road and a wooded strip - not waterfront

name: River Ridge Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 220 m frame, leaf-off) at 37.7286,-80.6746: the site loop wraps a Greenbrier River bend with its river side 20-40 m from the bank through sparse bare trees, no buffer; the operator states 'ALL sites are Riverfront' on its booking page

name: River Expeditions RV Park
evidence: satellite (Esri, 700 m frame) at 38.0141,-81.1204: RV lane on a wooded slope south of the lodge, off US-19; no water in frame - not waterfront

name: Princess Snowbird Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 400 m frame, leaf-off) at 38.8352,-79.3775: a row of pads with trailers sits under bare trees on Seneca Creek's north bank, 5-15 m from the water, below the campground's open upper field; the operator says the campground borders Seneca Creek. Assumes the bank row belongs to Snowbird, which Google's pin places north of the creek

name: Ashland Resort
evidence: satellite (Esri, 700 m frame, leaf-off) at 37.4111,-81.3364: RV sites strung along two hollow roads north of the office with cabins on a bench to the east; no open water in the hollow - not waterfront
